The character has fluffy curly black hair, thick eyebrows, expressive brown eyes, neatly trimmed beard, medium warm brown skin tone, and a charming Pixar-inspired facial design while maintaining realistic skin texture and proportions. He is wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="faded black vintage graphic t-shirt"}, relaxed dark pants, and clean white sneakers. Next to the earbuds case is a modern smartphone standing vertically on the wooden desk. The phone should also prominently display the {argument name="brand" default="LYNTILLA"} branding on the screen interface and subtly on the phone back or lock screen wallpaper. The screen shows a sleek luxury dark-mode music player UI with elegant typography, glowing playback controls, and premium branding aesthetics. Two wireless earbuds branded with {argument name="brand" default="LYNTILLA"} are naturally placed in the foreground on the desk with realistic reflections and glossy materials. Add a small indoor plant, warm lamp glow, and cinematic blurry background elements to create a cozy premium indoor atmosphere. Scene styling: cozy warm indoor cinematic lighting, premium luxury product photography aesthetic, cinematic depth of field, realistic shadows and reflections, ultra detailed textures, shallow focus photography, soft orange tungsten lighting, dreamy modern ambiance, photorealistic materials, miniature toy-scale proportions, balanced luxury composition. Style references: Pixar-style realism + Disney 3D character design + Apple-style product photography + luxury lifestyle branding aesthetic. Camera: close-up eye-level cinematic shot with natural perspective depth. Rendering: 8K ultra detailed, octane render, unreal engine, ray tracing, global illumination, HDR lighting, hyper realistic textures. items.prompt: Create a "Weekly Schedule" template image for VTubers and streamers. Horizontal 16:9, size 1920x1080, flat, neat, print-like design (vector style). The overall look should be cute pastel tones (gentle colors like pale pink, mint, lavender), prioritizing readability without clutter. Absolutely do not include sample text (e.g., 'Plan here', 'SAMPLE', 'MEMO', etc.). ・The right 40% of the screen is empty space for later synthesis of a standing character image. Do not draw people, animals, mascots, or silhouettes. The background should only be a faint gradient and subtle abstract patterns of small stars/hearts/dots. items.title: Minimalist Editorial Fashion Sketch
items.prompt: A refined, expressive fashion sketch illustration style, combining elegant, thick black ink lines with soft monochrome wash renderings. Sharp, smooth, confident black brushstrokes blend with loose, gestural sketch lines, featuring line thicknesses varying from ultra-thin hairlines to bold, expressive accents. Soft, controlled shading using subtle, cool gray watercolor strokes and light, graphite-like gradients creates a soft dimension without overwhelming contrast. The color palette remains very limited: crisp white, soft neutral gray, and charcoal black, with carefully placed dark gray accents appearing only on fabrics or specific design elements. The facial rendering is delicate and luminous, with soft, transparent shadows around the eyes, nose, lips, and jawline. Fine crosshatching and feathery strokes are applied sparingly to enhance depth while maintaining a clean look. The hair is rendered using flowing, energetic ink strokes with overlapping strands and a semi-abstract brush texture. The clothing is rendered in solid black! The background is {argument name="background color" default="deep orange"}! The overall technique resembles a {argument name="illustration style" default="luxurious editorial fashion illustration"} created with ink brushes, fineliners, diluted watercolors, and graphite pencils on smooth white paper. Dynamic, unfinished sketch strokes remain visible around the silhouettes, giving the artwork a spontaneous, hand-drawn feel. High negative space, elegant minimalism, a sophisticated balance between precision and expressive sketching, no typography, no logos, no watermarks, vertical composition, 9:16 aspect ratio!
